record.one_liner: Cloud phone system (calls, SMS, contact center) with an API and webhooks for business integrations
record.auth_notes: Basic auth with an API ID and API token generated under Integrations > API keys in the Aircall dashboard (own/private integrations). OAuth 2.0 install flow for apps acting on behalf of other customers; install completed by an Aircall Admin and yields a permanent access_token.
record.access_notes: critic: access paid_plan -> self_serve_trial. Vendor pricing page says all plans include API access and that new accounts get free access to test before committing. The Professional-plan restriction applies only to calling the Messaging API directly; integrations can use it on any plan. No free plan exists, trial length not stated on the pricing page.
record.api_notes: REST Public API with webhooks documented separately; Messaging API (SMS/MMS/WhatsApp) documented but direct use needs Professional plan.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict blocked -> ready, main_blocker paid_plan -> none. Core API is included on all paid plans and a free test account is offered; only direct Messaging API use needs Professional. MCP is a vendor-hosted read-only beta.
